ptLiteralVerse: Ora, a serpente era mais astuta que todos os animais do campo.
enLiteralVerse: Now the serpent was more crafty than all the animals of the field.

literalTranslations.pt: A serpente era astuta mais do que todo animal do campo.
literalTranslations.en: The serpent was crafty more than every animal of the field.

literalTranslations.pt: A serpente era a mais prudente dentre os animais.
literalTranslations.en: The serpent was the most prudent among the animals.

literalTranslations.pt: A serpente era mais sagaz que todos os viventes da terra.
literalTranslations.en: The serpent was more shrewd than all living creatures of the earth.
